excerpt: From Intern to Employee: Designing Internship Programs That Lead to Full-Time Employment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Bringing your parents or grandparents to Canada for an extended stay just got easier with the Super Visa. Designed to promote family reunification, the Super Visa Canada allows eligible parents and grandparents of Canadian citizens or permanent residents to visit for up to five years at a time, with the option to extend. Unlike regular visitor visas, the Super Visa offers long-term flexibility and multiple entries, making it a popular choice
